# Main Branch

> A technology release aggregator that tracks the latest releases and updates from 28+ tech sources across the development ecosystem.

Main Branch collects release notes, changelogs, and updates from RSS feeds and GitHub/API endpoints, transforms and validates them, and presents them in an organized interface built with Next.js.

## Pages

- [Home](/) — Featured recent releases and AI/ML highlights
- [All Releases](/releases) — Browse and filter all tracked releases
- [Timeline](/timeline) — Chronological view of releases by year
- [About](/about) — About the project
- [Notifications](/notifications) — Configure RSS notification preferences

## API

- [RSS Feed](/feed) — RSS feed of the latest releases
- [Sync API](/api/sync) — Triggers the data pipeline (protected)
- [AI Explain](/api/releases/explain) — AI-powered release explanations

## Tracked Technologies

### Frontend
- Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Nuxt, Remix, Vite, Tailwind CSS

### Backend & Runtimes
- Node.js, Deno, Rust, Go

### AI & Machine Learning
- OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, PyTorch

### Tools & Platforms
- TypeScript, GitHub, MDN, Vercel, Cloudflare

## Categories

Releases are organized into the following categories:
- **frontend** — Frontend frameworks and libraries
- **backend** — Backend runtimes and languages
- **ai-ml** — AI and Machine Learning tools
- **llms** — Large Language Models
- **tools** — Developer tools
- **devops** — DevOps and infrastructure

## Data Pipeline

Sources are fetched every 6 hours via a cron job. Each release goes through:
1. Fetching from RSS feeds or GitHub/API endpoints
2. Transformation and version extraction
3. Validation with Zod schemas
4. Persistence to PostgreSQL (deduplicated by technology + version)

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, React Server Components)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Neon) with Prisma ORM
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Language**: TypeScript
